item: Vacuous-fault reach audit: three tests whose injected fault was never reached are fixed with mutant proof, and a guard stops a loop over a callback-filled empty list
refs: parent sweep: R385 (the os/time/open guards); no PR number in the row
summary: A dynamic reach audit (insert a recorder before every raise in each stub a test installs, run, list tests none of whose stubs raised) over 1158 tests and 97 throw-lambda tests: 247 unreached, nearly all correct guards (AssertionError must-not-call), default routes or name collisions; read by hand, 3 real. test_a_raising_tick_sink_never_breaks_a_merge: the sink is throttled to once per 2 s so it was never called; test_the_tick_reports_elapsed_seconds_and_never_a_fraction: SELECT 1 never ticks so both for-loops ran over empty lists and the raising detail was never asked; test_models_endpoint_and_put_report_active: overrode get_llm_client while the route uses get_ollama_client. Each fixed (interval 0, long statement, right dependency, non-empty assertions) and proved by a source mutant green under the old test and red under the new. New guard for the statically decidable shape (empty collection, filled only by a callback, asserted in a for-loop, no non-empty assertion): 20 pinned cases, 7 scanner mutants killed, flagged the old file on its two loops and two more tests that are reached today (hardened). Static scan of the broader shape flags 570 of 990 and is not a basis for a ratchet. Not covered: Mock side_effect, multi-line throw calls, parametrization folded. The audit scripts stay in the scratchpad (a mechanism, so a proposal).
